topic: ClickHouse driver and campaign data discrepancies
summary_markdown:
The session covered two main technical issues. First, [me] noted that the updated JetBrains ClickHouse driver (0.8.6) appears to execute every script query in a new session by default, causing errors like `Unknown table expression identifier 'tempFrames'`. The workaround is either rolling back the driver version to 0.6.3 or installing an older 0.9.X version.

Second, regarding campaign data on staging, [me] noted that pre-release numbers might not match production due to a new upper limit placed on footfall (unique users), which was previously absent in campaigns but is now present in dashboards. A decision was made to remove this limitation for campaigns, reverting the behavior to how it was before, even if it means the campaign data may no longer perfectly align with dashboard numbers.
decisions: The upper limit restriction on footfall (unique users) for campaigns will be removed, reverting the calculation method.
